verdict.rationale: Linear's own docs point to an interactive GraphQL API reference on Apollo Studio, with no download or login required. Users can browse the schema in the Schema tab and run queries in the Explorer tab. The docs also include query and mutation examples, and the endpoint supports schema introspection. missing for 10: evidence that the doc examples are pre-loaded as one-click runnable samples in the explorer, independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Our GraphQL API is explorable and queryable via Apollo Studio (studio.apollographql.com/public/Linear-API), no download or log in required. Click the Schema tab to browse the schema, and click the Explorer tab to run queries.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
